correlationId.title: Correlation ID
correlationId.description: Echo of the request correlation ID (or null if not provided).

dataJson.title: Data JSON
dataJson.description: JSON-encoded dispatch result. Null if success=false. Oversize results spilled to Platform Cache; see truncated/dataRef wrapper.

message.title: Message
message.description: Error type + message when success=false. Stack traces are intentionally omitted.

success.title: Success
success.description: True only if the handler/adapter executed and returned without exception.
